props.subTitle: Understanding Reflexology
props.title: What Is Foot Reflexology and How Does It Work?
props.text: Foot Reflexology is a traditional wellness therapy that applies controlled pressure to specific reflex points on the feet, which are traditionally believed to correspond with different areas of the body. Using a structured reflex-point technique, the treatment helps encourage relaxation, supports circulation in the feet, and relieves the sensation of tiredness after travel, long walks, or daily activities.
props.feature1Text: Uses targeted pressure on specific areas of the feet rather than general massage strokes.
props.feature2Text: Encourages a calming effect that many guests experience beyond the feet themselves.

items.question: Is Foot Reflexology the same as a Foot Massage?
items.answer: Not exactly. Foot Massage focuses on relaxing muscles and relieving soreness, while Foot Reflexology applies pressure to specific reflex points using a structured technique.

items.question: Does Foot Reflexology hurt?
items.answer: Most guests find the treatment comfortable. Some reflex points may feel more sensitive than others, but pressure is always adjusted according to your comfort.

items.question: Is Foot Reflexology suitable after walking around Bali?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book Foot Reflexology after sightseeing, shopping, hiking, or spending long hours on their feet.

items.question: Can I combine Foot Reflexology with another treatment?
items.answer: Absolutely. It is commonly paired with full-body massage, back massage, or facial treatments for a more complete wellness experience.

items.question: Is home service available?
items.answer: Yes. The treatment is available at our spa as well as selected villas and hotels throughout Seminyak and nearby areas.
